questionText:
Read the following case review on breaking news reporting and crisis journalism and answer the questions that follow:

On the morning of December 26, 2004, an unprecedented magnitude 9.1 undersea earthquake off northern Sumatra unleashed the devastating Indian Ocean Tsunami, obliterating coastal communities across Indonesia, Sri Lanka, India, and Thailand. At the news desk of a major news wire agency, sub-editors and correspondents faced an onslaught of fragmented, chaotic reports. To communicate the catastrophe with speed, accuracy, and clarity, the agency deployed the classic 'Inverted Pyramid' news structure.
